mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_LoginHistory ( factory_code, user_id, user_name, login_dt, login_ip, login_type, user_agent, login_result, fail_reason ) VALUES ( #{factoryCode}, #{userId}, #{userName}, now(), #{loginIp}, #{loginType}, #{userAgent}, #{loginResult}, #{failReason} )
mapper.select: SELECT login_history_id, factory_code, user_id, user_name, to_char(login_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS login_dt, login_ip, login_type, user_agent, login_result, fail_reason, to_char(logout_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS logout_dt, session_time, gov_interface_yn, to_char(gov_interface_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS gov_interface_dt, gov_recptn_rslt_cd, gov_recptn_rslt, gov_recptn_rslt_dtl, gov_fail_reason, gov_request_json, gov_response_json FROM TB_LoginHistory WHERE login_history_id = #{loginHistoryId}
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_LoginHistory SET logout_dt = now(), session_time = EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - login_dt))::integer / 60 WHERE login_history_id = #{loginHistoryId}
mapper.select: SELECT login_history_id, factory_code, user_id, user_name, to_char(login_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS login_dt, login_ip, login_type, user_agent, login_result, fail_reason, to_char(logout_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS logout_dt, session_time, gov_interface_yn, to_char(gov_interface_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS gov_interface_dt, gov_recptn_rslt_cd, gov_recptn_rslt, gov_recptn_rslt_dtl, gov_fail_reason, gov_request_json, gov_response_json FROM TB_LoginHistory WHERE COALESCE(gov_interface_yn, 'N') = 'N' ORDER BY login_dt DESC, login_history_id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT login_history_id, factory_code, user_id, user_name, to_char(login_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS login_dt, login_ip, login_type, user_agent, login_result, fail_reason, to_char(logout_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS logout_dt, session_time, gov_interface_yn, to_char(gov_interface_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS gov_interface_dt, gov_recptn_rslt_cd, gov_recptn_rslt, gov_recptn_rslt_dtl, gov_fail_reason, gov_request_json, gov_response_json FROM TB_LoginHistory WHERE ( DATE(login_dt) >= #{fromDate}::date AND DATE(login_dt) <= #{toDate}::date AND gov_interface_dt IS NULL ) ORDER BY login_dt DESC, login_history_id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_LoginHistory SET gov_interface_yn = #{govInterfaceYn}, gov_interface_dt = now(), gov_recptn_rslt_cd = #{govRecptnRsltCd}, gov_recptn_rslt = #{govRecptnRslt}, gov_recptn_rslt_dtl = #{govRecptnRsltDtl}, gov_fail_reason = #{govFailReason}, gov_request_json = #{govRequestJson}, gov_response_json = #{govResponseJson} WHERE login_history_id = #{loginHistoryId}
